raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (the 2026-01-18 transaction rows) delivers `amount` as currency-prefixed strings such as '$14.09', while earlier batches use plain numeric strings. All currency is USD, so stripping the '$' before casting yields the intended value, and a strict CAST still fails loudly on any unexpected format.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(replace(trim(amount), '$', '') AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
